name: With That, I Rest My Case
original_name: 别笑！夫人哄你签的离婚协议
overview:
To support the career of her lawyer husband, Fu Yan Xiu, Ning Ruo Wei gave up her identity as the "Legal Queen Vivian" to become a devoted wife for three years, willingly remaining the woman behind Fu Yan Xiu. When his first love, Jiang You Ning, returns, he works day and night tirelessly in her divorce case, leaving his wife to live in loneliness and desolation.

During a dinner party, Ning Ruo Wei faced prejudice because of her status as a housewife. Recalling her past glory and determined to make a triumphant comeback. She left a letter and returned to the law firm where she had worked, where she was welcomed. When she once again won a difficult case and recreated the "Legal Queen" myth, Fu Yan Xiu finally realizes, the opponent he so admired was actually his neglected wife. Ning Ruo Wei smiles faintly: Love yourself first, then love others. From then on, when they meet again in court, she is his opponent, but no longer the shadow behind him. (Source: Chinese = iQiyi )
